AssociateApi.name: AssociateApi
AssociateApi.doc: Maps an endpoint to your custom domain.

AssociateMergedGraphqlApi.name: AssociateMergedGraphqlApi
AssociateMergedGraphqlApi.doc: Creates an association between a Merged API and source API using the source API's identifier.

AssociateSourceGraphqlApi.name: AssociateSourceGraphqlApi
AssociateSourceGraphqlApi.doc: Creates an association between a Merged API and source API using the Merged API's identifier.

CreateApi.name: CreateApi
CreateApi.doc: Creates an Api object. Use this operation to create an AppSync API with your preferred configuration, such as an Event API that provides real-time message publishing and message subscriptions over WebSockets.

CreateApiCache.name: CreateApiCache
CreateApiCache.doc: Creates a cache for the GraphQL API.

CreateApiKey.name: CreateApiKey
CreateApiKey.doc: Creates a unique key that you can distribute to clients who invoke your API.

CreateChannelNamespace.name: CreateChannelNamespace
CreateChannelNamespace.doc: Creates a ChannelNamespace for an Api.

CreateFunction.name: CreateFunction
CreateFunction.doc: Creates a Function object. A function is a reusable entity. You can use multiple functions to compose the resolver logic.

CreateResolver.name: CreateResolver
CreateResolver.doc: Creates a Resolver object. A resolver converts incoming requests into a format that a data source can understand, and converts the data source's responses into GraphQL.

DisassociateApi.name: DisassociateApi
DisassociateApi.doc: Removes an ApiAssociation object from a custom domain.

DisassociateMergedGraphqlApi.name: DisassociateMergedGraphqlApi
DisassociateMergedGraphqlApi.doc: Deletes an association between a Merged API and source API using the source API's identifier and the association ID.

DisassociateSourceGraphqlApi.name: DisassociateSourceGraphqlApi
DisassociateSourceGraphqlApi.doc: Deletes an association between a Merged API and source API using the Merged API's identifier and the association ID.

EvaluateCode.name: EvaluateCode
EvaluateCode.doc: Evaluates the given code and returns the response. The code definition requirements depend on the specified runtime. For APPSYNC_JS runtimes, the code defines the request and response functions. The request function takes the incoming request after a GraphQL operation is parsed and converts it into a request configuration for the selected data source operation. The response function interprets…

EvaluateMappingTemplate.name: EvaluateMappingTemplate
EvaluateMappingTemplate.doc: Evaluates a given template and returns the response. The mapping template can be a request or response template. Request templates take the incoming request after a GraphQL operation is parsed and convert it into a request configuration for the selected data source operation. Response templates interpret responses from the data source and map it to the shape of the GraphQL field output type.…

GetChannelNamespace.name: GetChannelNamespace
GetChannelNamespace.doc: Retrieves the channel namespace for a specified Api.

GetDataSourceIntrospection.name: GetDataSourceIntrospection
GetDataSourceIntrospection.doc: Retrieves the record of an existing introspection. If the retrieval is successful, the result of the instrospection will also be returned. If the retrieval fails the operation, an error message will be returned instead.

GetGraphqlApiEnvironmentVariables.name: GetGraphqlApiEnvironmentVariables
GetGraphqlApiEnvironmentVariables.doc: Retrieves the list of environmental variable key-value pairs associated with an API by its ID value.

GetIntrospectionSchema.name: GetIntrospectionSchema
GetIntrospectionSchema.doc: Retrieves the introspection schema for a GraphQL API.

GetSchemaCreationStatus.name: GetSchemaCreationStatus
GetSchemaCreationStatus.doc: Retrieves the current status of a schema creation operation.

ListApiKeys.name: ListApiKeys
ListApiKeys.doc: Lists the API keys for a given API. API keys are deleted automatically 60 days after they expire. However, they may still be included in the response until they have actually been deleted. You can safely call DeleteApiKey to manually delete a key before it's automatically deleted.

ListApis.name: ListApis
ListApis.doc: Lists the APIs in your AppSync account. ListApis returns only the high level API details. For more detailed information about an API, use GetApi.

ListChannelNamespaces.name: ListChannelNamespaces
ListChannelNamespaces.doc: Lists the channel namespaces for a specified Api. ListChannelNamespaces returns only high level details for the channel namespace. To retrieve code handlers, use GetChannelNamespace.

ListDataSources.name: ListDataSources
ListDataSources.doc: Lists the data sources for a given API.

ListResolvers.name: ListResolvers
ListResolvers.doc: Lists the resolvers for a given API and type.

ListResolversByFunction.name: ListResolversByFunction
ListResolversByFunction.doc: List the resolvers that are associated with a specific function.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.doc: Lists the tags for a resource.

ListTypes.name: ListTypes
ListTypes.doc: Lists the types for a given API.

ListTypesByAssociation.name: ListTypesByAssociation
ListTypesByAssociation.doc: Lists Type objects by the source API association ID.

PutGraphqlApiEnvironmentVariables.name: PutGraphqlApiEnvironmentVariables
PutGraphqlApiEnvironmentVariables.doc: Creates a list of environmental variables in an API by its ID value. When creating an environmental variable, it must follow the constraints below: Both JavaScript and VTL templates support environmental variables. Environmental variables are not evaluated before function invocation. Environmental variables only support string values. Any defined value in an environmental variable is considered a…

StartDataSourceIntrospection.name: StartDataSourceIntrospection
StartDataSourceIntrospection.doc: Creates a new introspection. Returns the introspectionId of the new introspection after its creation.

StartSchemaCreation.name: StartSchemaCreation
StartSchemaCreation.doc: Adds a new schema to your GraphQL API. This operation is asynchronous. Use to determine when it has completed.

StartSchemaMerge.name: StartSchemaMerge
StartSchemaMerge.doc: Initiates a merge operation. Returns a status that shows the result of the merge operation.

TagResource.name: TagResource
TagResource.doc: Tags a resource with user-supplied tags.

UpdateApiCache.name: UpdateApiCache
UpdateApiCache.doc: Updates the cache for the GraphQL API.

UpdateApiKey.name: UpdateApiKey
UpdateApiKey.doc: Updates an API key. You can update the key as long as it's not deleted.

UpdateChannelNamespace.name: UpdateChannelNamespace
UpdateChannelNamespace.doc: Updates a ChannelNamespace associated with an Api.

UpdateSourceApiAssociation.name: UpdateSourceApiAssociation
UpdateSourceApiAssociation.doc: Updates some of the configuration choices of a particular source API association.

atRestEncryptionEnabled.doc: At-rest encryption flag for cache. You cannot update this setting after creation.

In most cases, Merged APIs (especially in your account) only require the API ID value or ARN of the merged API. However, you can still set its value. metricsConfig can be ENABLED or DISABLED.

certificateArn.doc: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the certificate. This can be an Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate or an Identity and Access Management (IAM) server certificate.

requestMappingTemplate.doc: The Function request mapping template. Functions support only the 2018-05-29 version of the request mapping template.

functionVersion.doc: The version of the request mapping template. Currently, the supported value is 2018-05-29. Note that when using VTL and mapping templates, the functionVersion is required.

maxBatchSize.doc: The maximum batching size for a resolver.

code.doc: The function code that contains the request and response functions. When code is used, the runtime is required. The runtime value must be APPSYNC_JS.

additionalAuthenticationProviders.doc: A list of additional authentication providers for the GraphqlApi API.

xrayEnabled.doc: A flag indicating whether to use X-Ray tracing for the GraphqlApi.

mergedApiExecutionRoleArn.doc: The Identity and Access Management service role ARN for a merged API. visibility.doc: Sets the value of the GraphQL API to public (GLOBAL) or private (PRIVATE). If no value is provided, the visibility will be set to GLOBAL by default. This value cannot be changed once the API has been created.

ownerContact.doc: The owner contact information for an API resource. This field accepts any string input with a length of 0 - 256 characters.

introspectionConfig.doc: Sets the value of the GraphQL API to enable (ENABLED) or disable (DISABLED) introspection. If no value is provided, the introspection configuration will be set to ENABLED by default. This field will produce an error if the operation attempts to use the introspection feature while this field is disabled. For more information about introspection, see GraphQL introspection.

queryDepthLimit.doc: The maximum depth a query can have in a single request. Depth refers to the amount of nested levels allowed in the body of query. The default value is 0 (or unspecified), which indicates there's no depth limit. If you set a limit, it can be between 1 and 75 nested levels. This field will produce a limit error if the operation falls out of bounds. Note that fields can still be set to nullable or…

resolverCountLimit.doc: The maximum number of resolvers that can be invoked in a single request. The default value is 0 (or unspecified), which will set the limit to 10000. When specified, the limit value can be between 1 and 10000. This field will produce a limit error if the operation falls out of bounds.

apiId.doc: The ID for the GraphQL API for which the resolver is being created.

fieldName.doc: The name of the field to attach the resolver to.

dataSourceName.doc: The name of the data source for which the resolver is being created.

PIPELINE: A PIPELINE resolver type. You can use a PIPELINE resolver to invoke a series of Function objects in a serial manner. You can use a pipeline resolver to run a GraphQL query against multiple data sources.

code.doc: The resolver code that contains the request and response functions. When code is used, the runtime is required. The runtime value must be APPSYNC_JS.

metricsConfig.doc: Enables or disables enhanced resolver metrics for specified resolvers. Note that metricsConfig won't be used unless the resolverLevelMetricsBehavior value is set to PER_RESOLVER_METRICS. If the resolverLevelMetricsBehavior is set to FULL_REQUEST_RESOLVER_METRICS instead, metricsConfig will be ignored. However, you can still set its value. metricsConfig can be ENABLED or DISABLED.

associationId.doc: The ID generated by the AppSync service for the source API association.

mergedApiIdentifier.doc: The identifier of the AppSync Merged API. This is generated by the AppSync service. In most cases, Merged APIs (especially in your account) only require the API ID value or ARN of the merged API. However, Merged APIs in other accounts (cross-account use cases) strictly require the full resource ARN of the merged API.

format.doc: The new type format: SDL or JSON.

awsRegion.doc: The Amazon Web Services Region in which the user pool was created.

defaultAction.doc: The action that you want your GraphQL API to take when a request that uses Amazon Cognito user pool authentication doesn't match the Amazon Cognito user pool configuration.

appIdClientRegex.doc: A regular expression for validating the incoming Amazon Cognito user pool app client ID. If this value isn't set, no filtering is applied.

UserPoolConfig.doc: Describes an Amazon Cognito user pool configuration.
